author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Does Adam Savage have any tips on how to avoid scrapes, bruises and cuts during builds? Has a fan ever inspired Adam to make an object, and has he ever wanted to create a clock by hand? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members crispychrissy, nahte1892  and olisig455, whom we thank for their support!
